local_archive.method: Read-only enumeration of capture_manifest.json and vision.json. Eligible cycles require six camera outputs and exactly 18 path-bound burst_latest JPEG SHA-256 entries. An exact pair requires the complete ordered path/hash tuple to occur both before and after deployment.
local_archive.media_retention: No media or request-level fingerprints copied to the repository.

required_acceptance_metrics.reason: No image-identical pre/post output pair exists in the retained local archive.

challenge_coverage.qualification: The counts are paired cases. Unpaired quiet ordinary cycles and schema equality are not detection-equivalence evidence.

exact_remaining_blocker: A retained compact-format output and an original-format output for the same 18-image burst with comparable model and request settings.
Independent biological labels for positive-event/precursor and difficult/UNKNOWN cases; the August 29-30 confirmed events have zero snapshots in the PR 76 replay.
Enough paired cases to estimate disagreement, missed-positive and false-positive rates with uncertainty.
actions_not_taken: No manufactured positive or relabeling of ambiguous disturbance.
promotion_decision: NO_EFFECTIVENESS_EQUIVALENCE_CLAIM; RETAIN EXISTING ROLLBACK AND PRODUCTION SETTINGS
